info.name: ConfigBridge Member B - integrated API
info.description: Synthetic TLS mock scenarios. Run core flow first. Failure scenarios create/activate their own configs. Isolation folder requires a separately provisioned tenant B and an ID belonging only to tenant A. API keys are local values; vendor keys belong in Vault. No exported credential values.

item.name: Live sources (OCSF)
item.description: Real free-tier sources stored as OCSF 1.9.0. Each Submit sets {{connector}}; then run Validate / Activate / Test / Run from 'Core API flow', then the records request here. GitHub needs the github_token secret stored first (see configs/README.md).
